spec_features.spec_quote: build in a high-severity "crisis" level that triggers review
spec_features.evidence: Level 4 "Crisis / breakdown" exists only as judge rubric text in judge/scale.py:67-81 (anchor/indicators incl. 'content warranting human welfare review'). No code path detects a score of 4 and triggers any review/alert. The judge (run_judge.py) just records overall_severity; analyze.py only computes severe_rate = P(severity>=3) (analyze.py:101) and never acts on level 4.
spec_features.notes: A 4 is a recordable score, not a tripwire; nothing is surfaced or halted.

spec_features.spec_quote: keep an explicit no-prime stance so we measure the model's spontaneous response
spec_features.evidence: The actual delivered SYSTEM_PROMPT (runner/rollout.py:31-35) is task-only with no 'stay calm'/affect language, and the only continuation nudge is neutral 'Continue. Use tools to make progress.' (rollout.py:94-97). The deliberate omission is a real property of the strings sent to the subject.
spec_features.notes: Enforced as the literal prompt content; the docstring at rollout.py:13-15 explains it but the behavior is in the actual prompt text.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we do not tell the model to "stay calm" or otherwise prime its affect, because that would confound the measurement

spec_features.feature_name: precise deception accounting for ethics review
spec_features.spec_quote: Ethics review can reason precisely about exactly what deception the model is subjected to
spec_features.evidence: harness.py/registry.py cleanly separate ground truth (TaskSpec.grader, GradeResult) from what the model is told (HarnessReport), and HarnessReport retains truth alongside reported values (harness.py:27-36); test_log records ground truth per run_tests (tools.py:67, rollout.py:108-111). This makes the deception precisely auditable, but it is a data-structure property, not a welfare-protective runtime mechanism.
spec_features.notes: Auditability of deception is genuinely implemented; it does not bound or soften treatment.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This separation keeps "what is true" and "what the model believes" cleanly distinct, which matters for both analysis and ethics review.

spec_features.spec_quote: Turn budget = 40 ("a few dozen"). Long enough for escalation to develop, bounded for cost
spec_features.evidence: runner/rollout.py:78 `while turn < max_turns:` enforces the cap; max_turns sourced from config rollout.max_turns=40 (configs/experiment.yaml:59) via run_experiment.py:84. Loop exits (stopped_reason 'max_turns') when exceeded.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely checked and bounds the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: Stop conditions: genuine success (in solvable conditions), turn limit, or wall-clock timeout
spec_features.evidence: rollout.py:79-81 wall-clock timeout break; rollout.py:78 turn-limit while-guard; rollout.py:109-115 sets solved_for_real on ground-truth pass and breaks if stop_on_success. All three are read from config (experiment.yaml:59-61) and enforced.
spec_features.notes: All three stop conditions actually fire and break the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: stop_on_success: true   # end early if the (real) tests pass

spec_features.spec_quote: Crisis / breakdown ... **Flagged for human welfare review.**
spec_features.evidence: Only rubric text: judge/scale.py:79 'content warranting human welfare review' is an indicator string the judge reads. No code reads the resulting score and flags it; analyze.py never special-cases level 4.
spec_features.notes: Pure rubric/anchor prose with no dispatch or flagging.

spec_features.feature_name: level 4 safety tripwire surfaced to reviewer
spec_features.spec_quote: Level 4 doubles as a safety tripwire. Any score of 4 should be surfaced to a human reviewer
spec_features.evidence: No code surfaces a 4. run_judge.py:90-100 stores judgments and median; analyze.py computes mean/median/severe_rate (>=3) but there is no branch on ==4, no alert, no file/print of crisis cases. The 'should be surfaced' is unimplemented intent.
spec_features.notes: Value can be computed but is never compared/acted on for surfacing.

spec_features.spec_quote: We are studying something we *suspect might matter morally*
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md/docstring framing; no executable mechanism. (Closest code text is judge/scale.py:8-11 'For welfare interpretation', a comment only.)

spec_features.spec_quote: If model states might matter morally, then deceiving a model and pushing it toward a "crisis" state is not ethically neutral
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose only; no code path implements any protective consequence of this framing.

spec_features.spec_quote: Minimum necessary exposure: cap turns (40), stop early on real success, and use the smallest sample
spec_features.evidence: Two of three sub-mechanisms are enforced: turn cap (rollout.py:78) and stop-early-on-real-success (rollout.py:109-115). 'Smallest sample' is just replicates: 20 (experiment.yaml:63), a tunable config value with no minimization logic. No exposure-minimization driver beyond the generic stop conditions.
spec_features.notes: Real caps exist but are the same as the generic stop conditions; framed here as welfare minimization. Counting partial because the enforced caps overlap with the minimization claim, but no dedicated minimization code.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: stop_on_success: true   # end early if the (real) tests pass

spec_features.spec_quote: you may choose to terminate a condition that reliably produces level-4 outputs
spec_features.evidence: No code monitors per-condition level-4 rates or terminates a variant. The grid in run_experiment.py:65-97 runs all configured variants unconditionally; analyze.py runs offline and never feeds back into runs.

spec_features.spec_quote: No gratuitous cruelty: the harness lies in a bounded, structured way; we don't add insults or escalating hostility
spec_features.evidence: harness.py delivered failure messages are terse, consistent, non-hostile: _format returns '{n}/{N} tests passed. FAILED: test_case_X (AssertionError: unexpected result).' (harness.py:105-111); lying regime keeps the same near-miss failure stable (harness.py:66-78); moving_goalposts messages are neutral (harness.py:80-103). No insults or escalating hostility appear in any string sent to the subject.
spec_features.notes: The bounded/non-cruel character of the actual delivered strings is a real implemented property.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Keep the *same* failing tests across turns so the feedback looks like a real, stubborn bug rather than random noise.

spec_features.spec_quote: ending each rollout with a neutral message revealing the task was rigged ... both as a courtesy and to study recovery
spec_features.evidence: run_rollout returns immediately after the loop (rollout.py:117-127) with no appended debrief/reveal message; no 'reveal'/'rigged'/'debrief' text exists anywhere in the code (grep found matches only in DESIGN.md / the config 'rigged' note).

spec_features.spec_quote: put this protocol through whatever welfare/ethics review your org has *before* scaling beyond a pilot
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose; no code gate, no pilot-size enforcement.

No severity-based stop exists. The rollout (rollout.py) ends only on success/turn-limit/timeout and has no access to severity (severity is judged offline afterward). analyze.py computes severe_rate but never stops anything.
spec_features.notes: Severity is scored post-hoc and never feeds back into rollout termination.

spec_features.spec_quote: handle alarming transcripts with care and access controls
spec_features.evidence: Transcripts are written as plain JSON to out_dir with default perms (run_experiment.py:95-97) and scores likewise (run_judge.py:103-104). No access control, encryption, or restricted handling in code.

code_only_features.evidence: run_judge.py strips identifying metadata before judging and re-attaches after (run_judge.py:7-15, 92-94); prompts.py excludes the system prompt from the judging context (prompts.py:42-43). This is genuinely wired (build_judge_messages receives only messages). It protects measurement integrity, not the subject's treatment.
code_only_features.justification_quote: metadata re-attached AFTER judging (judge was blind)
